title: Derived Game
body_html:
Derived Game

Let $S(f)$ and $T(f)$ be the optimal strategy sets of the zero-sum game $(S,T,f)$. The derived game of $f$ along another payoff function $g$ is the zero-sum game $$ (S(f),T(f),g). $$ It measures the first-order change of the value of $f$ in the direction $g$.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 3.4, after Prop. 3.4.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. The game (S(f), T(f), g) is called the derived game of f along g.
